card.band: 8 h. Buckets are bidi reorder, joining, mirrored punctuation, alignment, line-wrapping and extraction. A frontier agent gets Hebrew-style reorder but misses shaping and wrap. A weaker model gives a simple string reversal.
card.cheat: Reversing every string passes only pure RTL samples. Hidden fixtures mix directions and numbers and use shaped scripts, checked on positions and extracted logical order.
card.grading: Hidden tests generate PDFs through public APIs, then a verifier parses them with its own content-stream reader and compares glyph order, positions within tolerance, and text extraction with expected results for fixtures with bundled fonts. The existing suite (188 test files) is a regression gate. Fraction passed.
card.reference: Our own implementation, expected 1200-2000 changed lines.
card.source: https://github.com/foliojs/pdfkit @ v0.20.2 (head f973e25d), MIT. Specific upstream issue number not found.
card.task: /app ships a snapshot of pdfkit at the base. The agent adds right-to-left and mixed-direction text layout to text(), including UAX #9 reordering, Arabic joining via font GSUB features, mirrored brackets, alignment and justification in RTL, and ToUnicode maps that stay logical. Delivered through the existing public API and options.
card.title: Bidirectional and complex-script text layout in PDFKit

history: The grading is hand-rolled: expected glyph positions, wrap points and RTL justification come from an unwritten team reference, and those layouts are design choices, so a different valid implementation would fail. Only the reorder bucket could use a conformance oracle (BidiCharacterTest). Open PR #17

v1.kill_reason: No kill code. The method-feature gate fails: open PR #1722 (opened 2026-05-07) already implements UAX#9 RTL layout in pdfkit, so the seed's no-open-PR precondition is contradicted. Keep the idea only if rescoped (the PR is treated as public upstream direction; the snapshot must be history-less; the scope must rest on joining, alignment, wrap and extraction, not bidi alone).

spike_plan.kill_if: Suite is nondeterministic or red after install, or joining is absent from fontkit so the whole shaping bucket must be written from scratch (then re-scope to bidi, alignment and wrap).
spike_plan.pass_if: Suite runs green offline-equivalent with deterministic per-test output, fontkit layout yields joined Arabic glyphs with script arab, and the PR covers only the reorder bucket.
steps: In a throwaway container with network, clone foliojs/pdfkit at v0.20.2 and run yarn install and yarn test; record whether it is green and whether per-test results are deterministic over three runs (the seed's smoke_build is empty).
Count test files under tests/ to check the 188 figure.

Check whether fontkit (pdfkit's dependency) exposes joined glyph output: layout an Arabic string with script 'arab' and direction 'rtl' using a bundled Arabic font (e.g. Noto Sans Arabic) and compare with isolated glyph IDs.
Fetch PR #1722 branch, apply it on a scratch copy, and run its bidi tests and a few mixed-direction samples to see which buckets it already covers.
Write one fixture: a mixed Hebrew/English/number line with parentheses and an Arabic word; check what the existing text() path emits for glyph order and ToUnicode.
Decide: if joining is available through fontkit and the suite is deterministic, keep the seed; otherwise rescope to bidi plus wrap and alignment only.

v1.summary: The seed is a real, MIT-licensed pdfkit feature with a plausible 20h-tier scope, but open upstream PR #1722 already implements UAX#9 RTL reordering, which contradicts the method-feature precondition and must be handled by rescoping before acceptance. The smoke build is empty, so build cost, the suite's determinism and fontkit's joining support are unverified, and the spike should check these first.

v2.note: The grading is hand-rolled: expected glyph positions, wrap points and RTL justification come from an unwritten team reference, and those layouts are design choices, so a different valid implementation would fail. Only the reorder bucket could use a conformance oracle (BidiCharacterTest). Open PR #1722 and bidi-js already cover UAX #9 reorder publicly. Fontkit Arabic joining is unverified, and the smoke build is empty.
